scope: UI-to-source-owner data mapping for the Result Page Contract, not an API/DTO/database/local-store schema.

field_mappings.fallback: No species is fabricated; Medium requires explicit selection and Low requires manual selection before persistence.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Missing model identity remains unresolved and cannot be persisted.

field_mappings.required: required to choose the real confidence state
field_mappings.fallback: Do not expose numeric probability unless a Frozen page authority explicitly contains it.
field_mappings.error_behavior: No fabricated confidence state or probability.

field_mappings.required: required when the gate evaluates an image
field_mappings.fallback: Do not infer GOOD from missing data.
field_mappings.error_behavior: INVALID follows NO_FISH precedence then IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING; technical failures remain separate.

field_mappings.fallback: Omit timestamp when capture time is unavailable.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Never substitute current wall time as if it were capture time.

field_mappings.required: optional; only after explicit user action and granted permission
field_mappings.fallback: Leave empty on permission denial or GPS unavailability; Save is not blocked.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Never fabricate location; permission denial does not block Save Catch.

field_mappings.required: required for the five visual Result states
field_mappings.fallback: Return to Capture if source image is absent.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Never substitute generated or unrelated media.

field_mappings.fallback: Do not fabricate or silently select candidates.

field_mappings.error_behavior: Preserve draft on cancel or save error.

field_mappings.fallback: Never infer destination from a prior flow.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Preserve destination on retry; prevent duplicate record.

field_mappings.fallback: No successful route without a persisted identity.
field_mappings.error_behavior: Stay on Result and retry safely.

source_owners.GPS: Device location provider, invoked only after explicit user action/permission

verification_boundary: Source ownership is frozen at the page contract boundary only. No Android repository, Backend DTO/API, database, local-storage, sorting or ownership schema is changed or claimed.
